senses.definition_en: to impute; to ascribe; to attribute

examples.english: The false facts that are attributed, which if true would constitute a crime or offense, do not require a technical-legal definition, but rather that the accusation is sufficient for it to be inferred that the person to whom they are attributed has committed a criminal offense.
examples.ref: 2011 July 31, José Luis Buenestado Barroso, Derecho Penal Parte Especial y las Consecuencias Jurídicas del Delito en España, Bubok, →ISBN, page 402:
examples.text: Los hechos falsos que se imputan, que de ser ciertos serían constitutivos de delito o falta, no precisan de definición técnico-jurídica, sino que la denuncia sea suficiente como para que pueda deducirse que la persona a quien se le imputan ha cometido una infracción penal.
examples.translation: The false facts that are attributed, which if true would constitute a crime or offense, do not require a technical-legal definition, but rather that the accusation is sufficient for it to be inferred that the person to whom they are attributed has committed a criminal offense.

examples.english: The Bible presents three categories of imputations: Firstly, the sin of Adam is imputed to his descendants (Romans 5:12-14). Second, the sin of humanity is imputed to Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21), and third, the justice of God is imputed to those who believe in Christ […]
examples.ref: 2012, Rev Oscar Garcia, Exponiendo Conceptos Teológico y Doctrinales, WestBow Press, →ISBN, page 95:
examples.text: La Biblia presenta tres clases de imputaciones: Primeramente el pecado de Adán es imputado a su descendencia (Romanos 5:12-14). En segundo lugar, el pecado de la humanidad es imputado a Cristo (2 Corintios 5:21) y en tercer lugar, la justicia de Dios es imputada a los que creen en Cristo […]
examples.translation: The Bible presents three categories of imputations: Firstly, the sin of Adam is imputed to his descendants (Romans 5:12-14). Second, the sin of humanity is imputed to Christ (2 Corinthians 5:21), and third, the justice of God is imputed to those who believe in Christ […]

glosses: to impute; to ascribe; to attribute

senses.definition_en: to accuse

examples.english: And that lack, can I be accused of it being my fault?
examples.ref: 1871, José María de Pereda, Don Gonzalo González de la Gonzalera, chapter 18:
examples.text: Y esta falta, ¿se me puede imputar a mí como una culpa?
examples.translation: And that lack, can I be accused of it being my fault?

examples.english: They are seeking out the accusation of Pimentel and 24 other people, some already accused in the cause

examples.text: piden la imputación de Pimentel y otras 24 personas —algunas ya imputadas en la causa
examples.translation: They are seeking out the accusation of Pimentel and 24 other people, some already accused in the cause

examples.english: It's worth pointing out that the accused is also being investigated in relation to the recently-committed assault of an accountholder in Tijuana, therefore there is the possibility of accusing him of further crimes.
examples.ref: 2017 July 14, “Peligroso asaltante de Mexicali cae en Tijuana”, in Frontera.info:
examples.text: Cabe señalar que el imputado, también es investigado por el asalto a un cuentahabiente en Tijuana cometido en fecha reciente, por lo que no se descarta puedan imputárseles más delitos.
examples.translation: It's worth pointing out that the accused is also being investigated in relation to the recently-committed assault of an accountholder in Tijuana, therefore there is the possibility of accusing him of further crimes.
